name: Coupon Countdown Timer – Create popups, floating boxes, and sticky bars with countdown urgency
author: Repon Hossain

sections.description:
Boost Conversions with Urgency – Create Popups, Floating Boxes, and Sticky Bars with Countdown Timers!

Coupon Countdown Timer is a complete solution for any WordPress-based website that sells products, services, or memberships and wants to increase conversions with urgency marketing. This plugin helps you display a live countdown timer with coupon codes inside popups, floating boxes, or sticky bars – motivating visitors to purchase before the offer ends.

Unlike ordinary countdown plugins, Coupon Countdown Timer comes with a powerful drag-and-drop builder and dozens of readymade templates that allow you to design stunning campaigns without touching a single line of code. You can fully customize the layout, colors, fonts, button styles, and animations to match your brand identity. The plugin works with WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, membership sites, LMS platforms, or any WordPress checkout page where you want to display a time-limited offer.

With the Pro version, you can unlock the ability to set multiple coupon expiry dates for different campaigns – perfect for running flash sales, seasonal discounts, or limited-time offers for specific products or services. This powerful feature allows you to create highly targeted and personalized campaigns that reach different customer segments, helping you maximize conversions and increase average order value.

Why Website Owners Love Coupon Countdown Timer:
– Maximize FOMO (Fear of Missing Out): Show a real-time ticking clock to encourage visitors to take action quickly.
– Drive More Sales: Countdown timers are proven to boost conversions for any type of online business.
– Engage Visitors: Attention-grabbing popups, sticky bars, and floating boxes highlight your best deals.
– Quick Setup: Choose from pre-made templates or build from scratch with the drag-and-drop editor.
– Multi-Campaign Support: Run multiple offers at once with unique countdown timers.
– Works Everywhere: Compatible with WooCommerce, EDD, LMS, and any WordPress sales funnel.
– Mobile-Ready: 100% responsive design works perfectly on phones, tablets, and desktops.
– Fast and Lightweight: Built for performance so your site stays fast.

This plugin is ideal for flash sales, seasonal offers, event promotions, webinars, service discounts, limited-time membership deals, and time-sensitive campaigns. If you want to create urgency and convert more visitors into paying customers, this is the right tool for you.

Install Coupon Countdown Timer today, launch your first countdown campaign in minutes, and watch your revenue grow!

Features

  • Popups, floating boxes, and sticky bars to display coupon codes and timers.
  • Readymade templates to create campaigns quickly.
  • Drag-and-drop builder for full customization.
  • Multiple expiry date support for different coupons.
  • Live countdown timers to create urgency and boost conversions.
  • Responsive design that works perfectly on mobile and desktop.
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized code.
  • Works with WooCommerce, EDD, LMS, and other WordPress platforms.
  • Customizable text, colors, styles, and triggers.

External services

This plugin connects to an external API at https://couponcountdowntimer.com to retrieve the latest coupon templates. The connection is made automatically once a day through a scheduled task to keep the template library up to date. No personal or site data is sent to the external service during this process. The plugin only receives a list of available coupon templates in JSON format. This integration allows users to always have access to the most recent designs without needing to manually update anything. For more details, please review the service’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple coupons?

Yes! You can create multiple countdown timers with different coupon codes and expiry dates.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, and it also works with any WordPress checkout system such as Easy Digital Downloads, membership plugins, and LMS platforms.

Can I customize the popup design?

Yes, the drag-and-drop builder and pre-made templates allow you to customize the layout, colors, and text to match your brand.

Will it slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for speed.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, all popups, sticky bars, and floating boxes are fully responsive and look great on all devices.
